title: Installing the Tessl CLI
description:
Installing the Tessl CLI

Ready to get started with Tessl? This quick tutorial walks you through installing the Tessl CLI on your machine so you can start leveraging Spec Driven Development. 

Installation Steps:

- Prerequisite: Make sure you have Node.js version 22 or higher. 
- Install: Open your terminal and run the command:

npm install -g @tessl/cli

- Verify: Check that everything is working by running:

tessl --help 

Once the installation is successful, your next step is to initialize Tessl in a project!
